seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina sits directly next to Päivikki in the front row; the venue is asked to reserve both seats. Hearing loop, or receiver and headphone feed from the interpreter's mic, is pending with the venue and DJ. At dinner, seat Aino-Kaarina near the speakers' area but not next to a loudspeaker.

photographer: TBD - not yet booked. At least two alternative photographers are being sourced (availability for 12 Sep, 16:00 to about 23:00 package, portfolio sample, price). Lumière Fotografia is excluded per client instruction.
venue_notes: DATE FLAG: the system date is 2026-10-13, after the stated wedding date of 2026-09-12. Itzel Huerta must confirm the correct date before any contract is signed, deposit paid or print order placed. Only enquiries and availability requests are made on the stated date until then.

All vendor statuses are pending: no quotes or confirmations have been received yet, so budget total_eur is 0 against the 42,000 EUR cap. Request itemised quotes including VAT, service charges, overtime, shuttles and corkage, and hold about 5% (about 2,100 EUR) in reserve.

Ask the venue to confirm chapel, grove and dining hall availability for the 16:00 / 17:15 / 19:30 windows plus setup and teardown access. Share the running order with caterer, DJ, photographer and venue.
Chapel sound: ask the venue and DJ who supplies it. Request a headset or lapel mic for Päivikki, a backup mic, a sound check before 16:00, and confirm the chapel has power and a PA.

Nut-free: written confirmation is needed from the caterer, cake baker, any outside suppliers and the quinta's kitchen and bar staff, plus a per-dish allergen sheet, cross-contact controls, staff briefing and labelled vegetarian and children's plates. Eero's nephew carries an EpiPen. The menu is empty until the caterer supplies dishes.

Heat plan: if the forecast is above 32 C, cocktails move from the olive grove to the wine cellar. Forecast checks at 72h and 24h before, final call at noon on the day. Ask the venue about cellar capacity for 96, cooling or ventilation, bar and service access, and nut-free suitability. Brief caterer, photographer and DJ on both locations.
Late ceremony: shorten cocktails, never the ceremony. Dinner at 19:30 is the fixed anchor. Tell caterer and DJ; who signals the move to dinner is still to be agreed.
Music: Macarena is a do-not-play item to be written into the DJ contract or brief. Request a draft playlist for client approval.

Menu cards: print in Spanish and English; add Finnish only if 26 or more of Eero's family confirm. Ask Itzel for the confirmed Finnish-side count and RSVP deadline; ask the printer for the last order date and quotes with and without Finnish. Do not place the print order until the date is confirmed.

Dog: tell the quinta Pimienta is coming and ask about pet policy, permitted areas (chapel, grove, dining hall), any fee, water and a quiet resting spot. Who looks after Pimienta after the ceremony is to be confirmed with Itzel. Tell the caterer to keep the dog out of kitchen and food areas.

Shuttles: quote hotel to quinta before 16:00 and returns through the last departure at 01:30. Confirm vehicle count and capacity for 96, staggered departures, and whether guests need transport between chapel and grove.
No conflict with the R2 schedule has been identified yet; this depends on venue availability confirmation.
